objective: Offline content-hash discovery proof for the exact CELLECT dataset-v6 frozen separation requests before any kernel authorization
gate: N2 content-addressed request discovery must pass in the shared pure-stdlib step 0 and structured kernel consumer before N3 may be requested

proposed_nodes.evidence_basis: Owner-downloaded dataset v6 contains one exact request manifest and 77 unique exact request payloads totaling 1,391,458 actions. An independent content-addressed prototype resolves them with arbitrary filenames and parents, but the current shared step 0 requires the canonical bundle-manifest filename and manifest-relative payload paths, while the kernel derives frozen class and identity from transport paths. No supplier outcome exists; N2 is fail-closed pending shared repair.
proposed_nodes.kill_line: Any missing, empty, duplicate, wrong-hash, or transport-path-dependent request discovery is INVALID and opens no kernel or graph gate.
proposed_nodes.resume_condition: Orchestrator ports the content-addressed prototype into shared step 0, changes the kernel to consume structured frozen request records, reruns opaque-name and actual-v6 preflight tests, and separately supplies an authenticated under-five-hour runtime projection.
